description: Invites a person with a role on an app (project; otherwise the whole organization); resend: true sends their pending invitation again (a new link, once an hour).

project.description: The app where the role is given; without it: the whole organization.

reason.description: The reason for the assignment (in the log); "member of the organization" by default.

resend.description: true: sends the pending invitation of this address again, without changing anything else.

role.description: On the whole organization (developer by default); external sees only what it is granted. People who only use your internal apps: no invitation, Access on the app (grant_role, role access).

name: invite_member
title: Invite a person
